lines.en: I don't want to call her right now...
lines.zh: 我现在不想叫她……

lines.en: if library30 == True and futabadorm35 == False:
Futaba has seemed a little overworked lately...
lines.zh: Futaba 最近好像有点累过头了……

lines.en: I should probably leave her alone this afternoon.
lines.zh: 这个下午我大概该让她一个人待着。

lines.en: Maybe I'll go see her later or something?
lines.zh: 也许晚点再去看她？

lines.en: I tap on Futaba's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点下 Futaba 的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: : Hey, Futaba. What are you up to?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Futaba。你在忙什么？
: 哦，嗨！
: 嗯……我没在做什么啦。

lines.en: : I just left the library so I'm kind of just...walking around and looking for things to do.
lines.zh: : 我刚从图书馆出来，所以基本上就是……到处走走，看看有什么能做的。
: 那你还在[学校]附近？

lines.en: : Mhm...I was probably just going to head back to the dorms if-
lines.zh: : 嗯……我本来大概就要回宿舍去了，如果——

lines.en: : Wait, did you want to see me? I forgot to ask why you're calling.
lines.zh: : 等等，你是想见我吗？我都忘了问你为什么打电话来。

lines.en: : I don't want it to sound like I don't want to see you when I...definitely do.
lines.zh: : 我不想让这话听起来像是我……不想见你，可我明明很想。

lines.en: : Well then how about we meet up at the park over there?
lines.zh: : 那我们就在那边那个公园见吧？

lines.en: : Oh! That sounds good. I actually just passed it a few minutes ago but...I can go back.
lines.zh: : 哦！听起来不错。我几分钟前刚好路过那儿，不过……我可以走回去。

lines.en: : Great. I'll see you there then.
lines.zh: : 好。那就那儿见。
: 好、好的！那儿见！

lines.en: Futaba and I meet up at the park and spend the afternoon chatting about random things.
lines.zh: 我和 Futaba 在公园碰面，整个下午都在随便聊些杂七杂八的事。

lines.en: Several couples walk past us as we sit on the bench and each time, Futaba manages to get lost in thought watching them walk away.
lines.zh: 我们坐在长椅上，好几对情侣从面前走过，每一次她都会望着人家走远的背影出神。

lines.en: In a perfect world, I'm sure she'd want something like that for the two of us.
lines.zh: 要是在理想的世界里，她一定也希望我们俩能那样。

lines.en: She's always been one to get lost in daydreams, so I'm sure this student-teacher mask we're forced to put on in public can weigh heavily on her at times.
lines.zh: 她一向容易陷进白日梦里，所以我相信我们在人前不得不戴的这副师生面具，有时候真的会压得她很重。

lines.en: But even with the weight of that burden, her smile is able to brighten my day.
lines.zh: 但就算背着这份重量，她的笑容还是能把我的一天点亮。

lines.en: And who knows? Maybe some day, we'll be able to take that mask off.
lines.zh: 谁知道呢？也许有一天，我们能把那副面具摘下来。
$ futaba_love += 1
{i}Futaba 的好感度提升到了 [futaba_love]!{/i}
